title: Expose bounded customer reconciliation statement export for receipt, invoice and shipment evidence
description: Add a bounded read-only downloadable reconciliation statement per Customer that presents ERP-055 invoice evidence, ERP-073 receipt allocations, ERP-075 receipt-to-invoice allocation context and ERP-076 invoice-to-shipment links as separately labeled evidence classes. Provide a downloadable export (CSV or HTML) that reuses the same filtered, currency-separated, unknown-value semantics as the on-screen views. Do not create a general ledger, assert revenue recognition, contact customers, collect funds, execute production SQL, deploy, or release.
acceptance_criteria: The export lists recorded customer sales-invoice evidence, active ERP-073 receipt allocations, ERP-075 receipt allocation context and ERP-076 invoice-to-shipment links for one Customer without copying source rows or creating another master.
Users can apply bounded or paged filters for Customer, invoice identity, invoice-date range, currency, evidence class and allocation state using persisted fields only.

Invoice gross evidence, explicitly allocated-receipt evidence and arithmetic remainder remain in separate labeled columns; the export never subtracts one evidence class from another or asserts a settled, recognized or audited balance.
Amounts are grouped by currency and different currencies are never combined, converted or reassigned without an authoritative persisted conversion already belonging to the source evidence.
Draft, voided or cancelled source evidence is separately labeled and excluded from active evidence totals; missing or invalid links remain visible as unknown and are not repaired or reassigned.

The export states that it is operational evidence reconciliation, not a general ledger, audited Customer statement, revenue recognition, tax filing, payment demand or settlement confirmation, and includes the as-of date, filter criteria and generation timestamp.

Export generation is read-only, bounded (row/page limited), avoids per-row database access and does not call external services; authorization is revalidated before generation and fails closed on missing or unauthorized source data.
The export does not change Customers, Sales Orders, shipments, containers, invoices, allocations, receipts, balances, tax, finance or settlement records.

Unit and integration tests cover no evidence, partial and full allocations, missing-due-date or unknown-link cases, void/cancelled history, multiple Customers and currencies, bounded filters, authorization failure and source-record non-mutation; safe validation passes and browser acceptance is recorded as deferred during development.

scenarios: Open the customer reconciliation statement for a Customer with partial receipt allocations and linked shipments, apply a currency and date filter, generate the export and verify invoice gross, allocated-receipt and remainder evidence stay in separate labeled columns without a settled or recognized assertion.

Inspect partially linked, draft, voided, cancelled, missing-due-date and multi-currency evidence, generate the export and verify unknown values remain separate, no cross-currency total appears and no source record is changed.

human_gate.reason: Read-only evidence reconciliation export over repository records and non-production validation only. Customer contact, real collection, shipment execution, customs submission, accounting or tax action, production database mutation, deployment and release remain behind mandatory human gates.
